lines.en: label day140:
scene mollyarrives1
: ...and so you’ll be expected to turn in the transfer paperwork at the end of the day today, and {i}again{/i} when the second student arrives.
lines.zh: : ……所以今天放学前你要交转学手续，第二名学生到达时还要{i}再{/i}交一次。

lines.en: : Do you understand, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 明白了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Can’t you just fill out the paperwork for me? I’m tired and don’t even want to be here today.
lines.zh: : 你就不能替我把那些表格填了吗？我累了，今天根本不想在这儿。

lines.en: As you can see, Makoto is briefing me on what I’m supposed to do both before and after the first new girl arrives.
lines.zh: 如你所见，Makoto 正在向我说明，在第一个新女孩到来前后我都该做些什么。

lines.en: It doesn’t sound like a load of extra work, but it does sound like {i}work{/i} in general, and I don’t remember signing up for anything like that.
lines.zh: 听起来不算是多出来的大量工作，但听起来毕竟是{i}工作{/i}，而我不记得自己签过任何这类的东西。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives2
: Don’t give me that crap, Sensei. Especially after I’ve done virtually everything for you.
lines.zh: : 别跟我来这套，Sensei。尤其在我几乎替你把一切都做完之后。

lines.en: : All you need to do is sign your name and agree to take on responsibility for her.
lines.zh: : 你只需要签个名，同意承担对她的责任。

lines.en: : But what if she’s another Yumi? Two delinquents in one class is too many.
lines.zh: : 可万一她是另一个 Yumi 呢？一个班里两个不良少女太多了。

lines.en: : In fact, one delinquent is too many. Can I trade in Yumi for someone else?
lines.zh: : 事实上，一个不良少女都太多。我能把 Yumi 换给别人吗？

lines.en: : Sana is easy to deal with. Can I get another one of her?
lines.zh: : Sana 好应付。我能再要一个她那样的吗？

lines.en: scene mollyarrives3
: Actually, it’s funny you mention that. I was just thinking on the way to[school] this morning that Yumi’s gotten significantly better as of late.
lines.zh: : 其实，你提起这个还真巧。我今天早上来[school]的路上就在想，Yumi 最近明显变好了。

lines.en: : Better in what way? All she does is insult me and skip[school].
lines.zh: : 哪方面变好了？她除了骂我和逃[school]什么都不干。

lines.en: : Well, that’s true. But at least her grades are improving when she {i}does{/i} decide to show up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒是真的。但至少她{i}来上课{/i}的时候，成绩在提高。

lines.en: : You haven’t been actually {i}tutoring{/i} her, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真的在给她{i}补习{/i}吧？

lines.en: Well...I guess there was that one time on the roof, but...I can’t think of any other time.
lines.zh: 嗯……我想是有过天台那一次，不过……我想不出别的了。

lines.en: Either way, I’m not going to let Makoto know that.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我不会让 Makoto 知道那件事。

lines.en: I’ve felt myself slowly slipping to her bad side, so any chance I get to make myself look good, I will gladly take.
lines.zh: 我感觉自己正慢慢滑向她的黑名单，所以只要有机会让自己看起来好一点，我都会欣然接受。

lines.en: : Actually, my dear Makoto, I {i}have{/i} been tutoring Yumi. That’s why I’ve been so tired lately.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我亲爱的 Makoto，我{i}一直{/i}在给 Yumi 补习。这就是我最近这么累的原因。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives4
: Huh...Is it wrong that my initial instinct is to call you a liar? I seem to have a harder time believing that than I should.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我的第一反应是想说你撒谎，这算不对吗？我似乎比应有的程度更难相信你。

lines.en: : Me? A liar? How dare you.
lines.zh: : 我？撒谎？你竟敢。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know I graduated top of my class in the Navy Seals, and I’ve been involved in numerous secret raids on-
lines.zh: : 我告诉你，我可是以全班第一的成绩从海豹突击队毕业的，还参与过无数次秘密突袭——

lines.en: scene mollyarrives5
: Sensei...This is no time for joking around.
lines.zh: : Sensei……现在不是开玩笑的时候。

lines.en: : Class is about to start and the {i}transfer{/i} student should be showing up at any moment.
lines.zh: : 马上要上课了，{i}转学生{/i}随时可能出现。

lines.en: : Why did you say ‘transfer’ so strangely right there? Are you upset about this or something?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说「转学」的时候为什么语气那么奇怪？你对这事不满还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene mollyarrives6
: Hmm...Upset isn’t the right word.
lines.zh: : 嗯……「不满」这个词不对。

lines.en: : I just don’t see the point in it if she’s not a {i}real{/i} transfer. She’s just moving over from some other class.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，如果她不是{i}真正的{/i}转学生，那这事就没意义。她只不过是从别的班调过来而已。

lines.en: : {i}It’s already annoying enough having to compete with nine other girls, so...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}光是要和另外九个女孩竞争就已经够烦了，所以……{/i}

lines.en: : What was that last part? You started whispering and I couldn’t really hear you.
lines.zh: : 最后那句是什么？你在小声嘀咕，我没听清。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives7
: Oh, that was nothing. Just talking to myself.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。只是自言自语。

lines.en: : Now if you’ll excuse me, I’d like to sit down before you take attendance so as to not risk any imperfect marks on my record.
lines.zh: : 那么失陪了，我想在你点名之前坐好，免得我的记录上出现任何不完美的污点。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives8
Makoto vanishes into the classroom and I can hear the volume of the rest of the class go down a few notches once she does.
lines.zh: Makoto 消失在教室里，而她一进去，全班其他人的音量就降了几分。

lines.en: It’s hard for me to say how everyone else sees Makoto from their perspective, but it seems to me that, at the very least, she’s respected.
lines.zh: 我很难说其他人是怎样看待 Makoto 的，但在我看来，至少她是受人尊敬的。

lines.en: Or feared.
lines.zh: 或者受人畏惧的。

lines.en: But either way, she’s able to change the mood of the room...And that’s always an impressive feat.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，她能改变整个房间的气氛……而这本身就是一项了不起的本事。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and straighten out my blazer, getting ready to walk into the class.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，把西装外套拉平整，准备走进教室。

lines.en: But just as I’m about to open the door, I hear a set of quickened footsteps come to a sudden halt behind me.
lines.zh: 可就在我准备开门的时候，我听到身后一串急促的脚步声猛地停了下来。

lines.en: : So...{i}this{/i} is the place where wishes come true...
lines.zh: : 那么……{i}这{/i}就是实现愿望的地方……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives9
I turn around to find who I imagine is the transfer student.
lines.zh: 我转过身，找到了我想象中的那个转学生。

lines.en: It’s strange. Makoto says this girl isn’t a {i}real{/i} transfer, but she definitely looks like one.
lines.zh: 真奇怪。Makoto 说这女孩不是{i}真正的{/i}转学生，但她看起来绝对像。

lines.en: At the very least, she most certainly isn’t Japanese.
lines.zh: 至少，她肯定不是日本人。

lines.en: : State your name.
lines.zh: : 报上你的名字。

lines.en: : Molly MacCormack. Reporting for duty, sir.
lines.zh: : Molly MacCormack。前来报到，长官。

lines.en: : And where are you from, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你来自哪里，Molly？

lines.en: : Right down the hall, sir. Ms. Watabe’s class.
lines.zh: : 就在走廊那头，长官。Watabe 老师的班。

lines.en: : No, I meant what country you’re from. You don’t look Japanese.
lines.zh: : 不，我是问你来自哪个国家。你看起来不像日本人。

lines.en: : Ireland, sir. The Emerald Isle. I’ve come to serve you in any way I can.
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰，长官。翡翠岛。我是来为您效劳的，无论用何种方式。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things like that to me. I’ll twist them around in my head until they become something they most definitely are not.
lines.zh: : 请别对我说那种话。我会在脑子里把它们扭曲成绝对不是原本意思的东西。

lines.en: : Hmm...Interesting. Interesting.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有意思。有意思。

lines.en: : What’s interesting?
lines.zh: : 什么有意思？

lines.en: : The {i}fire{/i} burning in your eyes.
lines.zh: : 你眼中燃烧的{i}火焰{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you perhaps interested in [younger_girls]?
lines.zh: : 您是否恰好对[younger_girls]感兴趣？

lines.en: She’s too perceptive. She must be eliminated.
lines.zh: 她太敏锐了。必须被消灭。

lines.en: : Are you sure you should be asking your new teacher something like that?
lines.zh: : 你确定该向你的新老师问这种问题吗？

lines.en: : I am not, sir. I will remain in-line like a good soldier.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，长官。我会像个好士兵一样守规矩。

lines.en: : Please forgive me. I’m often told that I lack a filter and say things that people from your country normally keep to themselves.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我。我经常被人说缺少过滤器，把你们国家的人通常藏在心里的话说出口。

lines.en: : That...might become problematic in some cases. But I guess it could be fun in a weird sort of way.
lines.zh: : 那……在某些情况下可能会有点麻烦。不过我猜，用一种奇怪的方式来看也许会挺有趣。

lines.en: : What was that whole thing about this being the place where wishes come true, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你刚才说的「实现愿望的地方」到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : It’s from an anime, sir.
lines.zh: : 那是某部动画里的台词，长官。

lines.en: : So you’re the type that watches anime?
lines.zh: : 所以你是会看动画的那种人？

lines.en: : I love anime, sir. I would give my life for it.
lines.zh: : 我热爱动画，长官。我愿意为它献出生命。

lines.en: : Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly。

lines.en: : Yes, I'm Molly.
lines.zh: : 是的，我是 Molly。

lines.en: : Why was it you moved to Japan again?
lines.zh: : 我再问一遍，你为什么搬到日本来？

lines.en: : To serve you as my new master, sir.
lines.zh: : 为了侍奉您，我的新主人，长官。

lines.en: : That sounds great and all, but what is the real reason?
lines.zh: : 听起来不错，不过真正的原因是什么？

lines.en: : It is my dream to become the lead heroine of a harem, sir.
lines.zh: : 我的梦想是成为一部后宫作品的女主角，长官。

lines.en: : I am prepared to put my body and soul on the line in pursuit of a love worth dying for.
lines.zh: : 我已经准备好把身体和灵魂都押上去，追求一份值得为之而死的爱。

lines.en: : ...Exactly how much anime do you watch, Molly?
lines.zh: : ……你到底看了多少动画，Molly？

lines.en: : Enough to ruin real-life relationships.
lines.zh: : 多到足以毁掉现实中的恋爱关系。

lines.en: : I figured as much...
lines.zh: : 我就知道……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives10
: Yeaaaah...I don’t really blame you. Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 是、是吗……我也不怪你。哈哈哈……

lines.en: : I can go overboard pretty easily. But I’ll try to keep it to myself in class so I don’t mess anything up for you.
lines.zh: : 我确实很容易上头。不过在课上我会尽量收敛，免得给你添麻烦。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t need to worry about something like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，那种事你不用担心。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives11r
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么意思？

lines.en: : I don’t really take the same approach to teaching as most other people.
lines.zh: : 我教书的方式和大多数其他人不太一样。

lines.en: : So is this one of those like, free-form learning thingamajigs?
lines.zh: : 所以这是那种……自由式学习之类的东西？

lines.en: : I don’t really know what that means, but sure. We can go with that.
lines.zh: : 我不太知道那是什么意思，不过行吧。就这么说吧。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives12r
: So it’s cool if I be weird in class?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 那我在课上犯怪也可以吗？！真的吗？！

lines.en: : Uh...Well, yeah. I guess so.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯，好吧。大概吧。

lines.en: : I’m starting to think everyone in class is kind of weird in their own way anyway.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，反正班上每个人都有自己奇怪的地方。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives13r
: This is a wonderful day.
lines.zh: : 今天是美好的一天。

lines.en: : I can tell by how much your eyes are sparkling.
lines.zh: : 从你眼睛发光成这样我就看得出来。

lines.en: : Has Molly MacCormack, a cute foreigner all alone in a strange land, finally found the harem she is destined to lead?!
lines.zh: : 孤身一人在异国他乡的可爱外国少女 Molly MacCormack，终于找到了她注定要领导的后宫？！

lines.en: : Find out next week on...
lines.zh: : 下周同一时间请继续收看……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives10
: Um...Do you think you could help me come up with a cool anime title? I’ve got nothing right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你能不能帮我想个帅气的动画标题？我现在一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: : Just go introduce yourself and we’ll think of something later.
lines.zh: : 先去自我介绍吧，标题我们之后再想。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives9
: Sir, yes sir!
lines.zh: : 遵命，长官！

lines.en: scene black
I open the door for Molly and allow her to walk in before me.
lines.zh: 我替 Molly 打开门，让她走在我前面。

lines.en: But instead of walking up to the front of the class and introducing herself, she wanders right over to Rin’s desk...
lines.zh: 但她没有走到教室前面做自我介绍，而是径直走向 Rin 的课桌……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives11
: Huh? Molly?
lines.zh: : 哈？Molly？

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : To think...my arch nemesis would be here of all places...
lines.zh: : 没想到……我的宿敌竟然会在这种地方……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives12
: Wait. Molly, stop it.
lines.zh: : 等等。Molly，别这样。

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : Just when I was beginning to think this new life would be easy...
lines.zh: : 就在我开始以为新生活会轻松一点的时候……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives13
: Just when I thought I had a chance to thrive!
lines.zh: : 就在我以为自己有机会大展拳脚的时候！

lines.en: scene mollyarrives14
: Oh dear god, no.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，不要吧。

lines.en: : Woah! Does this mean Molly is going to be in our class now?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！这是不是意味着 Molly 以后就在我们班了？！

lines.en: : Please no. Anything but that.
lines.zh: : 求不要。别的都行，就这个不行。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with Molly? I think she's fun.
lines.zh: : Molly 怎么了？我觉得她挺有意思的。

lines.en: : I’ll never have another peaceful morning again. That’s what.
lines.zh: : 我再也不会有安宁的早晨了。就这个。

lines.en: : Oh stop. You’re just still mad about her calling you a nerd, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。你还在为她叫你书呆子生气，是不是？

lines.en: scene mollyarrives15
: {i}I’m not a nerd.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不是书呆子。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyarrives13
: Molly, please. Don’t do this right now. I’m literally begging you.
lines.zh: : Molly，拜托。现在别这样。我真的在求你了。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives16
: Rin, do you know this girl?
lines.zh: : Rin，你认识这个女孩吗？

lines.en: : No! I don’t! I’ve never even seen her before! I swear!
lines.zh: : 不！我不认识！我以前从没见过她！我发誓！

lines.en: scene mollyarrives17
: You dare look upon ME and feign ignorance?!
lines.zh: : 你竟敢看着我，还装作不认识？！

lines.en: : How can you call yourself the commander of the undead with a backbone so {i}weak{/i}?
lines.zh: : 脊梁{i}软成这样{/i}，你还有什么脸自称不死者的指挥官？

lines.en: scene mollyarrives18
: AHHHHH! KILL ME NOW!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！现在就杀了我吧！

lines.en: : {i}Tch-{/i}
: You should be ashamed. Turning your back on the work you’ve accomplished. The battles you’ve fought!
lines.zh: : 你应该感到羞耻。背弃了你取得的成就。你打过的那些仗！

lines.en: : Battles?...
: WHY ARE YOU DOING THIS TO ME?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这样对我？！

lines.en: : Me? Pfft. I’m not doing anything.
lines.zh: : 我？哼。我什么都没做。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives19
: You did this to yourself...
lines.zh: : 这是你自己造成的……

lines.en: scene black
Molly leaves Rin’s desk and Rin immediately buries her head in her hands, hiding her embarrassment from everyone.
lines.zh: Molly 离开 Rin 的课桌，而 Rin 立刻把脸埋进手里，不让大家看到她的尴尬。

lines.en: The transfer student, on the other hand...
lines.zh: 而那个转学生呢……

lines.en: scene mollyarrives20
: Greetings, fellow students! It is I...the gem of the Emerald Isle, Molly MacCormack, herself!
lines.zh: : 各位同学，大家好！正是我……翡翠岛的宝石，Molly MacCormack，本人！

lines.en: : And I am here to claim what is rightfully mine!
lines.zh: : 而我来到这里，是要夺回理应属于我的东西！

lines.en: : I have traveled across the land, searching far and wide...
lines.zh: : 我走遍这片土地，四处寻找……

lines.en: : Woo!~ Go Molly!~
lines.zh: : 哇哦！~ 加油 Molly！~

lines.en: scene mollyarrives21
: For you see, new-classmates...No, new FRIENDS! I’m a lovely [young]lass who was born {i}with a mission{/i}.
lines.zh: : 因为，新同学们……不，新朋友们！我是一个生来就{i}带着使命{/i}的可爱[young]少女。

lines.en: : And as the man you all call “Sensei” standing right next to me has agreed to be my new master-
lines.zh: : 而既然站在我旁边的、你们都称作「Sensei」的这个男人，已经同意成为我的新主人——

lines.en: scene mollyarrives22
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Since he has AGREED to be my new MASTER, I will now begin my journey.
lines.zh: : 既然他已经「同意」成为我的新「主人」，我现在就要开始我的旅程了。

lines.en: : But not just as a friend...and NOT just as a classmate...but as an {i}adversary{/i}.
lines.zh: : 但不只是作为朋友……也不只是作为同学……而是作为{i}对手{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives23
: And if ANYONE plans on taking me down...You will need to go through my master first.
lines.zh: : 而如果「任何人」打算打倒我……你们得先过我主人这一关。

lines.en: : Molly, I don’t think I ever agreed to-
lines.zh: : Molly，我不觉得自己什么时候同意过——

lines.en: scene mollyarrives24
: It’s been a pleasure meeting you all.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识大家。

lines.en: : And thank you, Sensei, for allowing me to be a part of your class.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你，Sensei，允许我成为你班上的一员。

lines.en: scene mollyarrives25
Scattered, awkward applause fills the classroom but I’m pretty sure it’s just Ami, Miku, and Futaba.
lines.zh: 教室里响起零零星星、尴尬的掌声，不过我敢肯定只有 Ami、Miku 和 Futaba。

lines.en: Everyone else remains silent and watches as Molly takes her seat...right in the front of class.
lines.zh: 其他人保持沉默，看着 Molly 坐到自己的座位上……就在教室最前排。

lines.en: Just when I was beginning to settle into my new, calm life as a teacher, someone like her shows up and sits as close to me as possible.
lines.zh: 就在我刚开始适应作为老师的平静新生活时，像她这样的人出现了，还尽可能地坐得离我更近。

lines.en: And now I can’t help but think of all the chaos she’s going to cause for not only myself...
lines.zh: 而现在，我忍不住去想她会带来多少混乱——不仅是对我自己……

lines.en: But for Rin, who is still crying out of embarrassment in the corner of the classroom.
lines.zh: 还有对 Rin，她还在教室的角落里因为羞耻而哭喊。

lines.en: scene black
$ molly_love += 1
$ day140 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
